description: A smartphone lies on a green bedsheet near a loose white charging cable, with both hands resting close by. The right hand reaches in and steadies the phone while the left hand brings the cable tip to the phone’s bottom edge, aligns it, and pushes it into the port; the left hand then lets go as the right hand keeps the phone in place with the cable now attached (right-hand object: phone; left-hand object: charging cable).
